card.text: Explore Bestla, a moon of Saturn, through its lightcurve-constrained shape approximation.

introduction.text: A published pole constraint places Bestla’s spin axis near ecliptic south. The displayed southward axis is representative and its rotational phase is arbitrary. Its elongation comes from photometry; depth is assumed. The grid marks unmapped terrain.

model.title: Light-curve shape approximation
model.summary: Approximate ellipsoid adopting minimum equatorial ratio 1.47:1 under uniform reflectivity. Equal short axes and volume scaling are assumed. The display axis represents a measured southward pole constraint; its exact direction and phase are unknown. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
